markscheme.html:
3a

A neutron collides with the nucleus of a heavy element (for example, uranium-235) and as a result, two smaller nuclei are emitted along with several neutrons.

The emitted neutrons collide with other nuclei of the heavy element, repeating the fission process and establishing a chain reaction.

3b(i)

The role of a moderator is to slow down fast moving neutrons.

Therefore a moderator must be a poor absorber of neutrons.

3b(ii)

The role of control rods is to control the power output/rate of nuclear fission in the reactor by reducing the number of neutrons.

Therefore control rods must be good absorbers of neutrons.

3c(i)

It is a spontaneous fission reaction, because there is no neutron on the left-hand side of the reaction equation.
